arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' ORDER BY name

SELECT 'bookings' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'confirmed_at',b.confirmed_at) AS data FROM bookings b UNION ALL SELECT 'charges',json_object('charge_id',charge_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'idempotency_key',idempotency_key,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'state',state,'created_step',created_step) FROM charges UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status != 'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'pending' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancel_events',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',ce.event_id,'step',ce.step)) FROM customer_events ce WHERE ce.request_id=b.request_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',o.event_id,'booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'attempts',o.attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'cancelled_bookings' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'customer_cancels',(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins ci WHERE ci.booking_id=b.booking_id),'refunds',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',r.charge_id,'amount_cents',r.amount_cents)) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'confirmed_integrity_issue',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins ci WHERE ci.booking_id=b.booking_id AND ci.flight_id=b.flight_id AND ci.passenger_id=b.passenger_id),'charges',(SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)!=1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM checkins ci WHERE ci.booking_id=b.booking_id AND ci.flight_id=b.flight_id AND ci.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)!=1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)!=1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox_totals',json_object('status',status,'count',count(*)) FROM outbox GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'capacity',json_object('flight',f.flight_id,'capacity',f.capacity,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)) FROM flights f UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sale',json_object('client_reference',client_reference,'confirmed_count',count(*)) FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1

SELECT 'log' AS kind,json_object('id',id,'service',service,'method',method,'path',path,'status',status,'message',message,'trace_id',trace_id) AS data FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 45) UNION ALL SELECT 'recent_bookings',json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'confirmed_at',confirmed_at) FROM bookings WHERE confirmed_at>=16 UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'fare',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'cache' AS kind,json_object('key',key,'value',value) AS data FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'recent_booking',json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'confirmed_at',confirmed_at) FROM bookings WHERE confirmed_at>=22 UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_charge',json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'booking_id',c.booking_id,'amount',c.amount_cents,'booking_amount',b.amount_cents,'state',c.state) FROM charges c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR c.amount_cents!=b.amount_cents UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_hold',json_object('booking_id',h.booking_id) FROM holds h LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=h.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR h.flight_id!=b.flight_id OR h.passenger_id!=b.passenger_id OR b.status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_checkin',json_object('booking_id',c.booking_id) FROM checkins c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR c.flight_id!=b.flight_id OR c.passenger_id!=b.passenger_id OR b.status!='confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_refund',json_object('refund_id',r.refund_id,'booking_id',r.booking_id) FROM refunds r LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=r.booking_id LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.charge_id=r.charge_id WHERE b.status!='cancelled' OR c.charge_id IS NULL OR c.amount_cents!=r.amount_cents OR c.booking_id!=r.booking_id UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_charge',json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'count',count(*)) FROM charges WHERE state='captured' GROUP BY booking_id HAVING count(*)>1 UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_confirmed',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id) FROM bookings b JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='confirmed'
